# StartupBar

> A free traffic-exchange network for software founders. Add one line of code to your site and a 36px bar promotes another verified startup — yours gets featured back on theirs.

StartupBar lets software founders grow together by embedding a lightweight widget on their site. The widget shows a rotating startup from the network, and in return your startup appears on other members' sites. All impressions and clicks are tracked, and founders get a dashboard with analytics, network rank, and click-through stats.

## Integration

To embed the widget, add this script tag to your site's `<head>` (or anywhere in the page). Replace `YOUR_STARTUP_ID` with the ID shown on your dashboard after approval:

```html
<script async src="https://startupbar.co/widget/loader.js" data-startup-id="YOUR_STARTUP_ID"></script>
```

Notes:

- The bar renders in a sandboxed iframe (36px tall) and never blocks page content.
- Placement is your choice: show the bar at the top or the bottom of your site, switchable from the dashboard.
- Theme is auto-detected (light/dark) from your site. Force it with `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"`.
- Visitors can dismiss the bar for their session; nothing is stored beyond a per-session ID used to de-duplicate impressions.
- The bar survives client-side navigation (Livewire, Turbo, Astro, SPA routers) without reloading or shifting your layout.
- Works on any site or framework — plain HTML, React, Next.js, Webflow, Framer, etc. No npm package needed.
- Installation is verified automatically; the dashboard shows whether the widget is detected and last seen.

## How it works

1. Apply with your startup name, URL, and one-liner.
2. Once approved, copy your script tag from the dashboard and install it.
3. Your site displays other members' startups; the network displays yours in return.
4. Delivery is reciprocity-weighted: the more impressions your site contributes, the more exposure your startup receives.

## Eligibility

Accepted: live software products, SaaS, developer tools, AI apps, and indie/founder-built web products with a working public website and a real landing page.

Rejected: sites that are not live yet, parked or placeholder pages, adult content, gambling, crypto pump/airdrop schemes, scams or MLM, link farms, pirated content, and anything illegal or unsafe. Sites that remove the widget after joining are removed from the network.

## Pricing

- Joining the network and listing one startup is free.
- Additional listings beyond your first are a one-time paid add-on.
- Featured spots cost $79 per month, with 8 slots available across StartupBar pages. Cancel anytime; the slot stays active until the end of the paid period.

## Featured spots

A Featured spot is paid visibility on StartupBar's own pages, not inside the widget. A featured startup appears in the sponsored rails beside the network, leaderboard and dashboard pages, and is highlighted in gold across the network cards, network list and leaderboard. Featured spots do not change widget delivery, impression counts, or leaderboard ranking. Payments are handled by Dodo Payments.

## StartupBid

StartupBid ([startupbar.co/startupbid](/startupbid)) is a standalone pay-to-rank leaderboard, separate from the widget network — no install and no account required. Anyone can bid on any website or X handle from $5. Bids are cumulative: every payment adds to that entry's lifetime total, and rank is determined purely by total amount paid. The board is public and live, shows clicks each entry received from the board, recent bids, and hourly trending entries. Payments are processed by Dodo Payments; bids are final and non-refundable. Bidding does not affect widget delivery, impressions, or the network leaderboard.

## Dashboard

After approval, founders get a dashboard at [startupbar.co/dashboard](/dashboard) with impressions served, impressions contributed, clicks, click-through rate, profile views, network rank, and 12-month trends.

## Optional signup attribution

Signup tracking is optional and uses the existing widget without a second widget installation. It is not automatic: the partner must connect its signup system to send signed reports of genuinely new accounts, or configure a dedicated signup-complete page for separately labelled browser page reports. Login, dashboard visits, refreshes, purchases and failed signups are not new accounts. Clicks are not signups, and signed partner reports are not independently audited or proof of causation.

Eligible referrals have a 30-day attribution window. Browser referral storage and reporting require the partner's analytics-consent signal, respect Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track, and clear browser-stored referrals on consent withdrawal, not existing server records. Signed server reports are not technically gated by the widget's consent signal; partners are responsible for applicable lawful basis, consent and visitors' choices. Partners must update their own privacy notices, keep signing keys server-side and send no customer names, emails or passwords. Attribution records are pseudonymous and link referral hashes to participating startups. Test reports are excluded from real totals. Disabling tracking stops new attribution, not historical retention. Daily cleanup removes unconverted referrals after 90 days and conversion records after 365 days; linked converted-referral records may remain until startup deletion. Deleting a startup deletes its attribution records. Results are available in the dashboard and weekly stats. See the [FAQ](/faq), [Privacy Policy](/privacy) and [Terms of Service](/terms).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the traffic-exchange network, how the widget works, and how to join.
- [Apply](/apply): Submit your startup to join the network. Provide your startup name, website URL, and a one-liner description.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Live ranking of all startups in the network by total impressions and clicks, with real-time stats.
- [Network](/network): Explore the full network of startups, trending startups by daily clicks, newly joined startups, and a sortable, searchable list.
- [Startup profiles](/startup/): One public page per approved startup with founder name, photo and quote, joined date, impressions served and contributed, clicks, and a live preview of the site.
- [StartupBid](/startupbid): Standalone pay-to-rank board. Bid from $5 on any site or @handle, cumulative totals decide rank, open to guests.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free listing, additional listings, and the $79/month Featured spot.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers on getting started, widget install, membership and approval, billing, featured spots, traffic and delivery.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How StartupBar collects, uses, and protects founder and visitor data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Rules for participating in the traffic exchange, application requirements, featured promotion, billing, and acceptable use.

## Optional

- [Widget Bar](/widget/bar): The embeddable widget itself. Rendered inside an iframe on members' sites to display rotating startup promotions.
